scope: Every inset component reachable through the transport data (directed, all transport files) plus two components used by saved routes; components reviewed earlier for surface connection keep their names.

cuts.reason: The Fire Altar's map square is lava to its edges, which touches the Fisher Realm's terrain below it.
The Water Altar's map square is water to its edges, which touches the Fisher Realm below and the Mind Altar beside it.
The Mind Altar's map square is filled to its edges, which touches the Water and Air altars beside it and the Fisher Realm below.
The Air Altar's map square is grass to its edges, which touches the Mind Altar beside it.
The Fisher Realm's map squares are grass to their edges, which touch the altars above them and unrelated terrain to the south and west.
The Abyss outer ring fills its map square; filler along its southern edge joins it to the Abyssal Nexus below.
The Crandor and Karamja Dungeon; a strip of terrain along its eastern edge joins it to the western part of the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon.
The Cosmic Entity's Plane fills its map square; dark filler joins it to the sea squares to the west and an island beyond them.

The player-owned house is an instance built from room templates, and the transport data models it as one tile, (1858, 7051): every house portal and teleport starts or lands there. Show only the template room holding that tile, not the whole template strip.
